subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Small object helper routines: indexed-collection search and index setters, interface-slot release, mode-switch status writers, vehicle status-field copier, named-entry list search, list-insert thunks, range-gated virtual dispatch, camera-director init, global graphics-resource block management, callback-address registration wrappers, DynMan lifecycle logging wrappers, forwarding thunks, global-buffer zero/free/init helpers, string/config utilities, predicate wrappers, reserved no-op slots and abnormal/corrupt code stubs. All packet owners are UnknownObject/UNKNOWN; class clusters below are evidence-based groupings, not proven class identities.

summary: Evidence-linked reconstruction of the generic runtime objects region. No function carries a proven owner class; each function is assigned to a conservative cluster keyed on shared fields, shared callees, or a shared behavioral pattern. The most defensible groupings are: a callback-address registration helper family (passing callback addresses through BooleanToIntConversion 0x00587B3E), a DynMan lifecycle family (StringSplitLoop + DebugLogWrite), and a forwarding-thunk family. Virtual-dispatch contracts (bounded index change callback, triple interface release, normalized-range update) are GUESS because their callee interfaces are not resolvable from this packet. Several functions are empty no-op slots, and two (0x004156FA, 0x00429FC2) are decompiler-corrupt or deliberate traps whose bodies are unreliable.

classes.name: IndexedCollectionSearch
classes.responsibility: Bounded index storage plus linear address search over a fixed-stride record array. Record stride 0xD0, array start this+0x0C, count this+0x10, stored index this+0x14.

classes.name: PolymorphicSlotReleaser
classes.responsibility: Holds up to three polymorphic interface pointers; each non-null pointer is invoked at vtable[0] with integer flag 1 and then nulled. Consistent with release/cleanup chaining.

classes.name: StatusValueWriter
classes.responsibility: Switch on mode field this+0x1C; for modes 0-5 writes a2 into a destination field of the sub-struct at this+0x20 (packet representation this+0xF0). Returns mode except for modes 1/4 where it returns a2.

classes.name: StatusFieldCopier
classes.responsibility: Copies status field values from the per-vehicle global block at 0x005ECDC8 (stride 18624 per index) into three target field arrays (this+0x4C, this+0x58, this+0x64), each value stored through StatusValueWriter 0x0040E710. A non-zero a3 flag reads the source; zero forces a 0 (reset).

classes.name: NamedEntryList
classes.responsibility: Linked list of string-named entries (head this+0x20, count this+0x2C). Each node carries a string pointer (+0x0) and next pointer (+0x4); a null string falls back to the global default byte_5EA438. Search by string via 0x00588410.

classes.name: IndexedListInsert
classes.responsibility: Resolves an element pointer as *(this+0x10) + 36*index (index read from a2+4) and forwards it to a list-insert or forward helper. Called by VehgenScnFileLoader and sub_4C6E80.

classes.name: ThresholdGatedCaller
classes.responsibility: Range-gated virtual dispatch: when this+0xAF4 is non-null and parameter a2 is in [0.0,1.0], invokes vtable+0x1C on the target object passing a2.

classes.name: CameraDirectorStateInit
classes.responsibility: Init/reset entry (invoked by 0x0040DA30 during camera-director reset/init): sets the first dword this+0x0 (vtable or parent pointer, ambiguous) then delegates remaining-field init to StructFieldInit 0x0040D490. Returns this for chaining.

classes.name: ModeStatePredicate
classes.responsibility: Mode gate: reads a single dword mode field at this+0x0 and reports true when it equals 3 or 4. Caller 0x004D4580 gates mode-dependent processing on this predicate.

classes.name: SimpleSetterAccessor
classes.responsibility: Trivial setter: unconditionally stores the argument at this+0x8 and returns the same value. Used by session-phase dispatch 0x0040D1B0.

classes.name: ByteGetterAccessor
classes.responsibility: Read-only getter returning the byte at this+0x24 with no side effects.

classes.name: GraphicsResourceBlock
classes.responsibility: Global graphics-resource block anchored at 0x005EA560: zeroing of a contiguous run of block globals plus destructor delegation, and a parameterless destroy wrapper. Block layout and per-field meaning are unknown.

classes.name: CallbackRegistrationHelper
classes.responsibility: Family of wrappers that pass a stored callback/stub code address to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and return its integer result, matching a legacy callback-registration ABI. Register, unregister and query variants.

classes.name: DynManLifecycle
classes.responsibility: Dynamic-manager lifecycle handlers (enter/setup/exit). Each runs a build-path split via StringSplitLoop (0x004D7A50) and, on a non-zero status, writes an entry message into the global debug buffer at 0x008AD25C via DebugLogWrite (0x004D7AA0).

classes.name: ForwardingThunk
classes.responsibility: Plain forwarding wrappers that pass one global or constant argument to a single utility call and return its result unchanged (or a constant). Callee identities are often known only by source name.

classes.name: ReservedNoOpSlot
classes.responsibility: Empty or trivial no-op stubs with no observable effect: void stubs, constant-return stubs and bare-return slots. Likely reserved placeholders or vtable slots.

classes.name: GlobalBufferHelper
classes.responsibility: Free, zero or init helpers over named global buffers: dword_5EA5D0 (free), dword_5EA5E8 (zero init), byte_5EC4C0 (clear), block at 0x7C569C (constant-state init).

classes.name: StringConfigUtility
classes.responsibility: String/config helpers: null-safe string comparison with a fixed fallback string, and a config-key reader that formats 'config=%s' into a length-checked buffer and copies it to a persistent buffer.

classes.name: PredicateUtility
classes.responsibility: Small boolean/range predicates: an integer range classifier (0/1/-1), a wrapper returning true iff its callee returns exactly 1, and a wrapper returning true iff a config search returns 2.

classes.name: AbnormalCodeStub
classes.responsibility: Decompiler-corrupt or deliberate-trap functions whose bodies are unreliable: a noreturn ud0 undefined-opcode trap and a fragment that increments a non-image address byte then tail-jumps.

interfaces.name: CallbackAddressRegistration
interfaces.purpose: Register/unregister/query a stored callback address; the callback address is passed to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) which produces an integer status returned to the caller.

interfaces.name: ReleaseInterface
interfaces.purpose: Conditional vtable[0] invocation with integer flag 1 on up to three stored interface pointers, nulling each after the call; consistent with release/refcount or cleanup chaining. Callee interface unknown.

interfaces.name: NormalizedParameterUpdate
interfaces.purpose: Virtual update call dispatched at vtable+0x1C on a stored target object (this+0xAF4), gated on the object being non-null and the parameter being within [0.0,1.0].

compatibility_contracts.name: BoundedIndexChangeCallback
compatibility_contracts.description: When a bounded index request is accepted, the owning object writes the index at this+0x14 and invokes its vtable+16 __thiscall callback with `this`; out-of-bounds requests are rejected without write or callback and the argument is returned unchanged.

compatibility_contracts.name: InterfaceSlotReleaseDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: Up to three stored interface pointers (this+0x18/0x1C/0x20) are non-null tested; each non-null pointer is invoked at vtable[0] with integer flag 1, then the slot is nulled. The callee interface is unknown; the release interpretation is DERIVED from the call pattern.

compatibility_contracts.name: NormalizedRangeVirtualUpdate
compatibility_contracts.description: When the target object pointer at this+0xAF4 is non-null and the parameter lies in [0.0,1.0], the vtable+0x1C __thiscall of that object is invoked with the parameter; otherwise nothing happens.

compatibility_contracts.name: CallbackAddressRegistrationAbi
compatibility_contracts.description: Callback register/unregister/query wrappers pass the callback's code address to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and return its integer result; the returned value is treated as success/registration status by legacy ABI callers.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleStatusBlockCopy
compatibility_contracts.description: Status fields are copied from the per-vehicle block at 0x005ECDC8 (18624-byte stride per index) into three target arrays on the receiver (this+0x4C/+0x58/+0x64); a zero a3 flag forces zeros (reset) instead of source values. Group source strides differ (74 dwords, fixed dwords 377/394, 17 dwords).

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalDebugBufferLifecycleLog
compatibility_contracts.description: DynMan lifecycle handlers run a build-path split via StringSplitLoop (0x004D7A50) and, when its status is non-zero, write an entry message into the global debug buffer at 0x008AD25C via DebugLogWrite (0x004D7AA0), returning the write result.

unresolved: All packet owners are UnknownObject/UNKNOWN; every class cluster above is an evidence-based grouping, not a proven class identity. Equal offsets on unrelated this pointers were not merged.
ShortComputation_e710's written destination is represented two ways in the packet (field this+0xF0 vs raw source this[8]+208); their structural identity is assumed, not proven.

field:obj:0x00000010 duplicates field:this:0x00000010 at the same byte offset under a different base name; treated as an extraction artifact of the same upper-bound read in SetBoundedIndexWithCallback.
BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) semantics are unresolved: registration bookkeeping vs pure boolean/pointer-to-int coercion; the meaning of its integer result is unknown.
GraphicsResourceDestructor identity/address and the layout and per-field meaning of the global block at 0x005EA560 are unknown; why a caller receives &dword_5EA560 after teardown is unclear.
The vehicle status block at 0x005ECDC8 uses mixed source strides (74-dword groups, fixed dword indices 377/394, 17-dword groups); the identity of each individual status field is undocumented.

Mode value meanings are unknown: modes 0-5 for ShortComputation_e710 (and why modes 1/4 return a2 instead of the mode), and modes 3/4 for ModeValidationCheck (prior analysis suggests replay/cinematic, not established here).

DynMan lifecycle parameters are undocumented: StringSplitLoop delimiter 2 and maximum lengths 507/519/953; the literal content of aDDevF119992002_12 is not in the packet; SeasonScoringReset appears in raw source but has no address evidence.
Global buffers dword_5EA5D0, dword_5EA5E8, unk_5EC6D0 and float flt_5EA618: their allocation/writer paths are unknown.
0x004156FA (ud0 trap) and 0x00429FC2 (byte increment at non-image address + tail-jump) are decompiler-corrupt or deliberate traps; their bodies are unreliable beyond the observed instruction.
0xCE8B0875 is not a normal game image address; the write target is likely misdecoded data.
LinkedListNodeInsert_0ad0 and sub_410AF0 are not in the packet callee lists; their contracts are unknown.
The semantic of value 2 in ConfigSearchResultIsTwo (section index, result code, or enum) is undocumented.
The content and length of the fallback string byte_5EA438 are not established.

Callback slots unk_42BB90, SessionType5Nullsub (0x0042CE20) and StubToNullsub (0x0042B8C0) may be function-pointer slots rather than data objects; whether deferred callbacks ever invoke them is unproven.
ClearEmptyStringBuffer lists callees 0x00587B3E and 0x00587BCF that are not called by its body; their relation to this function is unknown.
Global 0x005C3030 (aConfigS) appears in skeleton analysis but is not referenced by ReadConfigValueAndFormat's raw source; role unconfirmed.

The virtual callback targets (vtable+16 in SetBoundedIndexWithCallback, vtable[0] in ConditionalVirtualCallTriplet, vtable+0x1C in ThresholdGatedVirtualDispatch) are indirect and not statically resolvable from this packet.
